summary: Actinium Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing its compliance plan submitted to NYSE American to address non-compliance with continued listing standards (Section 1003(a)(ii): stockholders' equity below $4.0 million with losses in three of four recent years). The plan outlines actions management intends to take to regain compliance. No specific financial or operational terms were provided. The company previously received a deficiency notice on May 27, 2026. The NYSE American will review the plan and grant a cure period. Watch for exchange decision on plan acceptance and potential delisting if compliance is not restored.
